newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines lowers termed reverse repo rates.
newsitem.headline: Philippines lowers termed reverse repo rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Tuesday it has cut interest rates on its termed reverse repos and special series Treasury bills.
The reduction came a day after the average rates of regular Treasury bills went down due to oversubscription.

The one-month reverse repo rate was cut to 11 percent from 11.125 percent, the two-month repo rate was cut to 11.125 percent from 11.25 percent, and the three-month repo rate to 11.25 percent from 11.375 percent.

The Central Bank also cut the interest rate on its special series Treasury bills to 11.25 percent for 64-day bills from 11.375 percent, and to 11.525 percent for 128-day bills from 11.675 percent. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
